sources.title: Developer Exchange (DevEx)
factsSupported: Standard DevEx rate of 0.0038 USD per eligible Earned Robux (114 USD per 30,000).
Higher 0.0054 USD per Robux rate for certain Earned Robux from verified U.S. 18+ player spending.
Legacy 0.0035 USD per Robux rate for balances earned before 5 September 2025 at 10:00 PT.
Minimum of 30,000 Earned Robux to participate.
Eligibility requirements: minimum age 13, Roblox-verified email address, valid DevEx portal account, IRS form W-9 or W-8 on file, compliance with the Roblox Terms of Use and Community Standards.

sources.title: Developer Exchange — Help and Information Page
factsSupported: DevEx request handling, review, and payout process is operated solely by Roblox.
Supporting eligibility and account-standing context for the DevEx programme.

sources.title: Marketplace fees and commissions
factsSupported: Marketplace avatar item sale: creator receives 30%, Roblox receives 70%.
Avatar item bought inside an experience: item creator 30%, experience owner 40%, Roblox 30%.
Progressive Marketplace revenue share by price-floor multiple: 1x=30%, 1.3x=37%, 1.5x=41%, 2x=50%, 2.5x=57%, 3x=62%, 3.5x=65%, 4x=67%, 5x=69%, 6x and above=70%.
Progressive revenue share applies only to Marketplace purchases; in-experience purchases use the base commission.

sources.title: How do I make money?
factsSupported: Creators receive 70% of Robux spent on in-experience purchases such as developer products and passes; Roblox retains 30%.
Earned Robux must be converted through the Developer Exchange programme to become real currency.

sources.title: ECB Data Portal — Exchange Rates (EXR dataflow)
factsSupported: Euro foreign exchange reference rates used to derive USD cross rates for local-currency estimates.
Reference rates are published once per working day at approximately 16:00 CET and are not tradable bank quotes.

factsSupported: Scaled content abuse and doorway pages are policy violations, which is why numeric amount pages on this site are capped and manually approved.

factsSupported: Canonical URL guidance applied to calculator query-parameter states, which canonicalise to their clean owning route.

sources.title: Next.js — Cloudflare Workers framework guide
factsSupported: Next.js applications deploy to Cloudflare Workers through the OpenNext adapter with Workers Static Assets.

sources.title: Cloudflare adapter — Get started
factsSupported: Required wrangler configuration: `.open-next/worker.js` entry, `.open-next/assets` static directory, `nodejs_compat` and `global_fetch_strictly_public` compatibility flags, and the WORKER_SELF_REFERENCE service binding.
`initOpenNextCloudflareForDev()` enables Cloudflare bindings during `next dev`.

sources.title: Turnstile — Server-side validation
factsSupported: Turnstile tokens must be validated server-side against the siteverify endpoint, and each token may be redeemed only once.

sources.title: Workers Builds — Git integration
factsSupported: Cloudflare Workers Builds connects a GitHub repository to a Worker for automatic builds and deployments on push.
